intro: The Bahamas is low and flat, surrounded by shallow, crystal-clear water.

chapters.title: Islands and blue holes
text: Andros, the largest island, has many blue holes, deep underwater caves. Dean's Blue Hole, over 200 m deep, is one of the deepest in the world. Pigs swim at Big Major Cay in the Exumas.

chapters.title: Hurricanes
text: The low islands are very exposed to hurricanes and rising seas.

places.title: Landscape tour
places.intro: Places that show the variety of the Bahamas' landscapes. The numbers match the pins on the map.

items.name: Dean's Blue Hole
items.text: One of the deepest on Earth.
